init_scheduler_metrics: initialize scheduler metrics with tp_rank, pp_rank, and optional dp_rank for monitoring
report_prefill_stats: report prefill batch stats including token counts, throughput, and cache hit rates
report_decode_stats: report decode batch stats including generation throughput, speculative acceptance rates, and queue lengths
get_scheduler_loads: get comprehensive load metrics for the scheduler including running, waiting requests and memory usage
estimate_prefill_perf: estimate prefill performance metrics including FLOPS, read bytes, and write bytes for a given token count
